summary: Iteration 20 - Complete testing of restructured Assembly (İclas) module. All 13 backend tests passed. Frontend UI testing verified all new features: nested agendas/tasks structure, task sync to Tasks module, Eye icon detail view, date range filters, edit modal pre-fill, Excel export.

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent} - minor accessibility issue (same as previous iterations)

passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/assemblies with nested agendas[{title, tasks[{title, responsible_person}]}] creates assembly with IC-XXX auto-ID
Backend: Tasks auto-sync to /api/tasks with source='assembly' and assembly_id after assembly creation
Backend: PUT /api/assemblies/{id} re-syncs tasks (old tasks removed, new ones created)
Backend: DELETE /api/assemblies/{id} also deletes associated tasks from tasks collection
Backend: GET /api/assemblies?department=X filters by department correctly
Backend: GET /api/assemblies?date_from=X&date_to=Y date range filter works
Backend: Existing IC-001 assembly has correct nested structure
Backend: IC-001 tasks appear in Tasks module with [IC-001] prefix
Backend: Tasks without responsible_person are not synced (only valid tasks synced)
Backend: Assembly with empty agendas array works (no tasks created)
Backend: Assembly with agenda but no tasks works
Backend: PUT to nonexistent assembly returns 404
Backend: DELETE nonexistent assembly returns 404
Frontend: Assembly page loads with data-testid='assembly-page'
Frontend: Eye icon (data-testid='view-detail-{id}') expands detail view
Frontend: Detail view shows nested Gündəm→Tapşırıq→Məsul şəxs structure
Frontend: Department filter (data-testid='filter-dept') works
Frontend: Date range filters (filter-date-from, filter-date-to) work
Frontend: Add Assembly modal has nested form structure
Frontend: Agenda section (data-testid='agenda-0') with title input
Frontend: Add Task button (data-testid='add-task-0') adds tasks under agenda
Frontend: Responsible person select (data-testid='responsible-0-0') works
Frontend: Add Agenda button (data-testid='add-agenda-btn') adds new agenda sections
Frontend: Edit modal pre-fills nested agendas/tasks correctly
Frontend: Excel export button (data-testid='export-excel-btn') present
Frontend: Success toast 'İclas yaradıldı' displays after create
Frontend: New assembly appears in table with IC-XXX code
Frontend: Tasks page shows assembly-sourced tasks with [IC-XXX] prefix
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: DialogContent missing aria-describedby for accessibility - consider adding DialogDescription component
seed_data_creation: Test assemblies created during testing were cleaned up. IC-001 remains with 2 agendas and 3 tasks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 20 verified the RESTRUCTURED Assembly module: 1) Tasks are now NESTED under Agendas (structure: agendas[{title, tasks[{title, responsible_person}]}]). 2) Task sync works: when assembly is created/updated, tasks auto-sync to Tasks module with source='assembly' and assembly_id. 3) When assembly is deleted, associated tasks are also deleted. 4) Eye icon in table opens expanded detail showing Gündəm→Tapşırıq→Məsul şəxs nested view. 5) Form has nested structure with + Gündəm and + Tapşırıq buttons. 6) Date range filters (filter-date-from, filter-date-to) work. 7) Edit modal pre-fills nested agendas/tasks correctly. 8) Excel export button present. 9) Tasks page shows assembly-sourced tasks with [IC-XXX] prefix.

nested_agendas_tasks.details: Structure: agendas[{title, tasks[{title, responsible_person}]}]. Form has nested inputs with + Gündəm and + Tapşırıq buttons.

task_sync_on_create.details: After POST /api/assemblies, tasks appear in GET /api/tasks with source='assembly', assembly_id, and [IC-XXX] prefix in task_name.

task_resync_on_update.details: PUT /api/assemblies/{id} removes old tasks and creates new ones based on updated agendas.

task_delete_on_assembly_delete.details: DELETE /api/assemblies/{id} also deletes all tasks with matching assembly_id.

department_filter.details: GET /api/assemblies?department=X filters correctly. Frontend dropdown works.

date_range_filter.details: GET /api/assemblies?date_from=X&date_to=Y works. Frontend date inputs work.

eye_icon_detail_view.details: Single Eye icon in table (data-testid='view-detail-{id}') expands to show nested Gündəm→Tapşırıq→Məsul şəxs structure.

edit_modal_prefill.details: Edit modal pre-fills all fields including nested agendas and tasks correctly.

excel_export.details: Excel export button present. Uses xlsx library with restructured format (Iclas ID, Gundem, Tapshiriq, Mesul Shexs columns).

tasks_page_integration.details: Tasks page (Tapşırıqlar) shows assembly-sourced tasks with [IC-XXX] prefix in Kanban view.
